name: claude-code-mods
description: Claude Code mods: lines above the prompt, guards, panes and games.

plugins.name: agent-radar
plugins.description: One live line above the prompt per running subagent: time, tool count and what it's doing. /radar shows every agent and its messages.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky Bash commands and shows what they would change before they run.

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Your context window as a stacked bar above the prompt, a color per category, with token counts and the compaction point. /context-bar shows or hides it.

plugins.name: browser-lanes
plugins.description: Shows if this session has a Playwright browser and who holds it. /browser clean closes leftover browsers. A subagent that wants the browser waits until the one using it is done.

plugins.name: md-preview
plugins.description: Shows the Markdown files Claude edits, rendered like GitHub, in a pane next to the chat. Before and after side by side. /md opens it.

plugins.name: glance
plugins.description: One line above the prompt with what needs you: next meeting, PRs, Linear issues and Slack DMs. /glance lists them all.

plugins.name: merge-gate
plugins.description: Holds `gh pr merge` until CI passes and one Codex review (OpenAI's luna model) has run. A PR line above the prompt, and /gate shows the PR's status.

plugins.name: mission-control
plugins.description: /mission opens a live map of the main agent, its subagents and every tool call, plus a code map of the files they touch.

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: After each turn, 2 or 3 likely next prompts above the prompt. Press 1, 2 or 3 in an empty prompt to draft one, 0 to dismiss.

plugins.name: now-playing
plugins.description: What Spotify is playing, one line above the prompt: track, progress and the lyric being sung, with ⏮ ⏸ ⏭ buttons. /music controls it too. macOS.

plugins.name: prayer-times
plugins.description: The current prayer and how long is left, the next prayer, and zawal, above the prompt. Computed on your computer from your location; nothing is sent anywhere.

plugins.name: reels
plugins.description: YouTube Shorts in a terminal pane: plays while Claude works, pauses when Claude is done.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Step through the last turn's file edits, one diff at a time.

plugins.name: review-watch
plugins.description: A live line above the prompt for each running code review: Codex or a review subagent, its model, what it reviews, time, and Codex's latest output. A toast with the findings when it ends.

plugins.name: rulebook-guard
plugins.description: Writing and git rules: replaces em dashes in prose, and asks before git commit --amend, an unformatted push, or personal info in notes and commits.

plugins.name: session-saver
plugins.description: Names untitled sessions through unpause. /park saves where you left off, and a resumed session shows it.

plugins.name: snake
plugins.description: Snake in a pane while Claude works, paused when it's done. Opt-in, so nothing opens until /snake.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: A live forecast of the context window, with a prompt-cache countdown, drawn above the prompt.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: A prompt-cache line under your status line, from Claude Code's own cache figures: time left while warm, hit rate and misses, and how many tokens the next message re-caches once cold. /cache-clock setup adds it.

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Your plan's 5-hour and 7-day usage as small bars above the prompt, with the reset countdown and the session's cost.

plugins.name: where-am-i
plugins.description: A live recap above the prompt: goal, doing now, waiting on you, next. /where for a longer one.

plugins.name: switchboard
plugins.description: Picks the model for each subagent that names none, with OpenAI's Decisions API or Jev, from its short label only. One line per spawn above the prompt; /route shows each pick and what each subagent cost.

plugins.name: openai-balance
plugins.description: Your OpenAI API credit above the prompt: an estimated balance with a gauge, today's spend, where the money mostly went, and the last call. /openai-balance shows the breakdown.
